rules.summary: Expose declared self-owned proprioceptive, HUD and inventory state; exclude host/server implementation internals.
Visual candidates must be inside the active camera frustum; baseline base horizontal FOV is 70 degrees.
Visual candidates must be inside the scenario-declared effective visual distance and client-equivalent availability.
Current visual facts require unobstructed player-facing evidence after geometry and visual-effect filtering.
Expose visible block/object surfaces rather than full radius/chunk contents behind them.
For sensed entities expose only current player-facing properties, not hidden health, inventory, AI goals or server-only metadata.
Expose only sounds the equivalent client/player could receive or hear; do not add exact hidden source state.
Expose only messages delivered to this player by the active chat/channel/server rules.
Expose ordinary non-debug player-facing UI only when the capability is declared; never use it to leak underlying server objects.
Loaded, ticking, simulated or ticketed chunk state never grants policy perception by itself.
Observed absence is valid only where current sensor coverage is sufficient; otherwise state is unknown.
Memory cannot query authoritative unseen server state to refresh or verify remembered facts.
Sequence, schema, trace and exact timing metadata may support transport/evaluation but are not automatically policy-visible.
Expose semantic outcomes of this agent's own actions without hidden target/world diagnostics.
Recipe-book-equivalent access must be explicit; never passively inject the complete server recipe registry.
Evaluator, operator, debug-overlay and admin-only state is isolated from the baseline policy input.
